mode.tooltip: Fullscreen hides panels and titlebar automatically. Maximize keeps window buttons and works best with Cinnamon's 'Intelligently hide panel' option.

resync-on-switch.description: Auto-resync window geometry when switching back to a dedicated workspace
resync-on-switch.tooltip: Fixes X11 fractional scaling offset or clipping when returning to a dedicated workspace.

floating-topbar.description: Show floating top bar on hover in Fullscreen mode
floating-topbar.tooltip: Reveals a macOS-style top bar with window title and controls when moving the cursor to the top edge of the screen.

floating-topbar-skip-custom.description: Hide floating top bar for apps with custom titlebars
floating-topbar-skip-custom.tooltip: Automatically disables the floating top bar for apps that draw their own titlebar in fullscreen (such as Chrome and VS Code).

settle-delay.tooltip: Delay after switching workspaces before resizing the window. Use 0 ms on 100% display scale; 100-250 ms works well on fractional scaling (e.g. 125%).

restore-maximize-delay.tooltip: Delay between resetting the window frame and re-maximizing when returning a previously maximized window to its original workspace.

exit-hotkey.tooltip: Returns the focused window to its original workspace and restores its previous state/geometry.
